description: Accessibility per station, keyed by station SLOID (join with stations.geojson). atlas_stop_point = atlas stop-point-v2 row; reference_points, toilets, parking_lots, contact_points = atlas rows of the station; relations = step-free access, tactile marks and contrasting areas between a reference point and an element (element_sloid is an edge, toilet, parking lot or contact point). bfr_wheelchair = BfR_Haltestellendaten flags as published. Each row gives the wheelchair boarding class for the period valid_from..valid_to: Autonomie (independent boarding), Rampeneinsatz (ramp operated by staff), Voranmeldung (advance notice needed), Ersatztransport (replacement shuttle), keinZugang (no access), keineInfo (no information). The prefixes sg / ug are the publisher's column prefixes; in the data they line up with track-bound vehicles (train, tram) and vehicles that are not track-bound (bus). That reading is ours and is not stated on the dataset page.
source: atlas stop-point-v2, reference-point-v2, toilet-v2, parking-lot-v2, contact-point-v2, relation-v2 (actual-date files); BfR_Haltestellendaten.csv
